notes: Initial production Hermes-on-AgentCore image pin (Task 20, M4). Built by .github/workflows/build-hermes-image.yml from apps/infra/hermes/Dockerfile; base pinned by digest (M4-R31) to `base.image` above -- nousresearch/hermes-agent publishes no numbered tags upstream, only date-stamped vYYYY.M.D tags plus latest/main, so the brief's `:0.21.3` tag placeholder does not exist. `base.version` is what that digest reports via importlib.metadata.version('hermes-agent'); `base.pulled` is when it was pulled as `latest` and digest-pinned. This JSON is the promotion RECORD; the Dockerfile's FROM line is what actually builds -- keep them in lockstep by hand. dev.tag equivalent: this file has no per-env split yet (single `tag` field) because AGENTCORE_HERMES_IMAGE is dev-only until M6 -- service-stack.ts reads `tag` for dev and leaves prod empty. Bump `tag` here in a PR (+ a CDK deploy) to promote a new build; the workflow itself never writes this file.
